formulas.formula: Your brain's home base: plan the day, build habits, track money, and earn XP for every win.
Any date in the month. Blank = this month.
Any date in the week. Blank = this week. Weeks start on Monday.
1. Type your name and the month above. Everything else follows.
2. Brain Dump: empty your head. Then sort each item: Today, This week, Later, Delegate or Let go.
3. Weekly Planner: just 3 priorities a day. Tick them off for XP.
4. Habits: tick each day. Streaks and % fill in by themselves.
5. Mood & Energy: a 10-second check-in each day. Spot your patterns.
6. Goals: break each goal into tiny steps and tick them off.
7. Money: income, bills (tick when paid) and a few spending buckets. Log spending on Spending Log.
8. Rewards: every win earns XP. Level up and treat yourself with the rewards you pick.
Pick 3 habits, not 12. Add more once they stick.
Missed a day? Your best streak is saved. Just tick today.
Doing a boring task with someone (even on video) makes it easier.
Set a 10-minute timer and stop when it rings. Starting is the hard part.
White cells: type or tick here.
Tinted cells: these fill in for you.
You're doing better than you think. Thank you for your purchase!

section_bars.label: =IF(TRIM('Start Here'!C5&"")="","MY LIFE HQ",UPPER('Start Here'!C5)&"'S LIFE HQ")

formulas.formula: =TEXT(TODAY(),"dddd, mmmm d")&"  -  one thing at a time. You've got this."
Get it out of your head. Sort each thing, give it a size, and tick it when it's done. Tiny = 5 minutes. XP: tiny, small and big tasks earn different points.
Ask Sam to pick up the kids

section_bars.label: ="MY WEEK  -  "&UPPER(TEXT('Start Here'!$L$7,"mmm d")&" TO "&TEXT('Start Here'!$L$7+6,"mmm d"))

Tick each day you do it. Streak = days in a row up to today (or the month's end). Missed one? Your best streak stays.
A 10-second check-in: mood and energy from 1 (rough) to 5 (great), hours of sleep, meds, and one win.
